hypothesis: Three bounded simplifications test whether delayed Dow/strict breakout constraints suppress useful daily pullback entries
baseline: Unchanged tamukai_stocks_daily_20260926 signals and same-cost buyhold; not selectable

entry_rules.inherited: baseline protocol all entry conditions unless explicitly replaced below
entry_rules.prior_day_breakout: Replace close>max prior3 high with close>previous day high only
entry_rules.sma63_trend: Replace Dow with SMA21>SMA63 only; SMA63 must be valid
entry_rules.warmup: 2016-07-12 onward, prior3 SMA21 valid; SMA63 variant requires 63 bars

exit_rules.rules: Unmodified baseline simulate: next open entry if above prior3 stop; fixed symmetric target; gap open; both-hit stop first; entry-day exits; final-close liquidation; one position

final_period_prior_exposure: All periods previously disclosed for baseline; retrospective reuse, not untouched holdout
cost_and_fill_model: Baseline simulate unchanged; one-way main 0.001/stress 0.002 notional costs; Yahoo backward-adjusted OHLC DATA_LIMITED; no dividend reinvestment/tax/interest
position_sizing_and_currency: JPY 100000 per independent sleeve, total 1000000; all cash including costs, fractional adjusted shares, no leverage or rebalancing
selection_rule: Jev selects maximum one eligible candidate or none from training-only summaries; deterministic gates cannot be overridden; all ineligible means stop
jev_policy: Maximum 2 API requests using experiment-specific reservation ledger; independent training validation before request. Per-candidate advance/reject/insufficient and overall selection in one request, eligible choices only. Confidence below 0.8 or ineligible choice yields none and stop; 0.8 is an uncalibrated conservative research progression rule, not forecast accuracy.
cross_symbol_rule: Final positive net profit in at least 6 of 10 symbols; 9/7 subsets are diagnostics only
code_identifier: scripts/research_tamukai_stocks_jev.py; baseline module reused; all source/data hashes frozen before training
